item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00192","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C21","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C02, issued only weeks earlier, supplies nearly the entire concrete drafting structure and much of the exact language of the child: a dispute involving multiple carriers and represented employees; the identical Railway Labor Act and National Mediation Board findings; a nationwide threat to essential transportation service; a thirty-day presidential report; and the section 10 prohibition on changing the disputed conditions. The child principally substitutes different carrier representatives and a different labor organization. C21 and C06 use the same machinery and closely parallel language, but C02 is the closest in time, grammatical form, nationwide predicate, and multi-carrier framing.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS a dispute exists between the carriers represented by the Eastern Carriers' Conference Committee, Western Carriers' Conference Committee and Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committee, and certain of their employees represented by the Brotherhood of Locomotive Firemen and Enginemen","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Akron, Canton & Youngstown Railroad Company and certain other carriers designated in the list attached hereto and made a part hereof, and certain of their employees represented by the Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers","explanation":"Both open with the same multi-carrier dispute formulation, changing only the identification of the carriers and employee representative."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive the country of essential transportation service","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive the country of essential transportation service","explanation":"The two central findings are effectively verbatim, including the nationwide essential-transportation predicate."},{"child_excerpt":"The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.","parent_excerpt":"The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.","explanation":"The reporting command is verbatim."},{"child_excerpt":"As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the Board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement shall be made by the carriers ... or their employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.","parent_excerpt":"As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by any of the carriers involved or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.","explanation":"The same statutory standstill mechanism appears in the same position and nearly identical wording, adapted to the child’s named carrier committees."}]}
